# Best Western — US-English site, content and interaction inventory

> **Historical and superseded.** This was researched for the incorrect global Best Western site. The active product is the single-hotel Tejvivaan redesign. Use [03-tejvivaan-site-inventory.md](03-tejvivaan-site-inventory.md) for current content and page coverage.

> Historical scope. This document covers the earlier, incorrect global Best Western site. The user replaced that brief with the single-property Tejvivaan website. Use [03-tejvivaan-site-inventory.md](03-tejvivaan-site-inventory.md) for the active product.

Research date: 14 October 2026 (Asia/Calcutta). Scope confirmed by user: US-English website, worldwide hotels presented in English, and linked services. Translated country websites are excluded. Account pages were inspected in the user's signed-in browser with permission; no personal values are included here.

## 1. Read this coverage statement first

This is a verified core-page inventory plus a large discovered-URL register, **not a complete export of every page's body content**. Firecrawl discovered 8,036 URLs in the broad domain map; 7,936 matched US-English paths. Additional section maps and inspected routes produce the deduplicated register at the end. Each register row carries its actual evidence status. A mapped URL is not proof that its page is live or its content has been captured.

The direct homepage Firecrawl scrape failed. Browser access initially encountered a device check; after the user signed in, live account inspection succeeded. Public search-index extracts supplemented the browser. Some extracts include hidden components, outdated campaigns, and duplicate responsive markup. Those must not be interpreted as simultaneously visible live content.

33 source routes received page-level inspection, including partial extracts and sample templates. The register contains thousands of property routes whose individual bodies remain unreviewed. Payment, booking confirmation, populated reservation details, populated points history, and third-party completion flows were not executed. An empty account cannot establish every populated-account state.

Status vocabulary:

- **Live browser / signed-in browser:** rendered page or form inspected on the research date.
- **Public extract:** source body inspected through indexed retrieval; freshness varies.
- **Sample template:** one property instance inspected; other properties can differ.
- **Linked:** destination observed in navigation, but destination body not inspected.
- **Mapped:** URL/title returned by discovery only; requires validation.
- **Required / unverified:** preservation requirement inferred from a known journey; exact existing screen still needs capture.

## 3. Shared search and reservation controls

Sources: [search](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/book/hotel-search.html), [homepage](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US.html), [groups](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/reservations/groups.html).

| Control | Options / content |
|---|---|
| Destination | City, street address, attraction or airport search; selected destination persists through booking |
| Dates | Arrival/departure pickers, night count; current dates in live controls are session-dependent |
| Occupancy | Rooms, adult count and child count per room; larger-group route |
| Rate selection | Standard best rate, AAA/CAA, points, corporate, AARP/senior, government/military, promotion |
| Special identifiers | Corporate or promotion code fields where applicable |
| Points | Points search option; availability and membership constraints |
| Actions | Apply rate, search, edit stay, update, collapse search |
| Destination change | Confirmation to continue to search results or retain current page |
| Modification errors | Date changes unsupported; selected room unavailable; contact hotel or central reservations |

Child-age fields, maximum occupancy, date restrictions, and rate-code validation require live booking verification. Preserve backend rules rather than deriving limits from a single example.

### Search filter taxonomy

Observed amenities include internet, breakfast, parking, pool, pet accommodation, fitness, eco-friendly facilities, restaurant, EV charging, smoke-free stays, business center, extended stays, airport shuttle, oversized parking, rider-friendly services and accessible rooms. Keep brand and review filters as data-driven groups. Sorting option labels were not fully exposed in the public extract. Error states include no matching filters, unsupported destination, unavailable hotel with nearby alternatives, and failed currency conversion. [Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/book/hotel-search.html)

### Property and room content contracts

Each hotel record needs its property code, name, brand, address, direct phone, reservation contacts, gallery with captions, overview, room inventory, amenities, policies, geographic position, review data, and categorized nearby places. Nearby categories in the inspected property include business, attractions, dining, education, recreation, shopping and transport. FAQ covers breakfast, pets, check-in/out, internet, pool and gym. Preserve each hotel's actual answers; never apply one hotel's policies to the whole chain. [Sample](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/book/hotels-in-london/best-western-london-peckham-hotel/propertyCode.84204.html)

Room records need room type, beds, occupancy, amenities, images, rate plans, refundability, member eligibility, currency, availability and terms. Observed room-page states include no rooms, no filter matches, insufficient points, login-required member rates, and a warning that changing rate category requires reselecting room rates. The sample exposes rates/rooms views and King/Queen filtering; this is not a universal bed-type list. Prices in indexed extracts are historical snapshots, not usable live rates. [Sample](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/book/cambridge/hotel-rooms/best-western-plus-cambridge-hotel/propertyCode.66080.html)

The public tier matrix contains Blue, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Select. Keep qualifying-night thresholds, bonus percentages, exceptions, effective year and footnotes in structured content rather than baked into layout. The 2026 extract lists 5/7/15/25 qualifying nights for the four elite tiers, with 10/15/30/50 percent bonuses. Early/late stay benefits are availability-dependent. A separate older campaign appears in the same indexed page: verify active content against the live site before publishing. [Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/best-western-rewards.html)

### Enrollment form

Observed fields: given/family name, country, state, city, phone and phone type, email, new password, communication consent, earning choice, CAA member identifier/conversion option, or airline selection and frequent-flyer identifier. Password guidance requires at least ten characters plus a letter, number and symbol. Include duplicate-account failure, required-field indicators, terms/privacy/incentive disclosures, join/cancel actions and welcome/return-to-previous-page/book actions. Conditional country fields require verification. [Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/rewards/join.html)

### Redemption catalog

Observed live categories: partial-points stays; free nights; partner digital cards; Best Western electronic cards; airline conversion; charity. Query categories include SHOPPING, GIFTCARD, TRAVEL and CHARITY. The catalog has country-dependent availability, popularity/title/ascending-points/descending-points sorting, denomination selection, quantity, add-to-cart, detail expansion, pagination, cart count, total points and checkout entry. Sample results included USD hotel gift cards and regional partner cards. Preserve amounts and point costs from a current catalog feed. No redemption was submitted. Cart, insufficient-balance validation and final redemption confirmation remain unverified.

## 6. Signed-in account: detailed inventory

### A01 — Member dashboard

[Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/rewards/member-dashboard.html). Live, signed in.

- Greeting, membership number, current points, membership tier, progress toward next tier, nights remaining, current-tier benefits and all-benefits link.
- Shortcuts to account activity, reservations, wallet, offers, earning and redemption.
- Upcoming-stay area and view-all action; an empty reservation state was observed.
- Campaign eligibility period, terms link, member-offer area, credit-card promotion.
- Travel/shopping partner routes; points payment, gifted nights, charity and redemption routes.
- Populated activity rows and historical rewards calculations were not available in this account.

### A02 — Digital wallet, inside dashboard

- Tabs for usable, expired and used items. Used items can reference associated reservations.
- Sorting by item type, amount or expiry date appears in the source; empty state invites adding an item.
- Add dialog chooses gift card or free-night award.
- Gift-card form: card identifier and PIN.
- Award form: award identifier, sequence identifier and PIN.
- Add, cancel and close actions. Both form variants were opened without entering values or submitting.
- Source exposes invalid-number/PIN, invalid/expired award, zero-balance card, service failure and successful-add messaging; those outcomes were not triggered.
- A populated wallet's item menus, deletion and redemption behavior remain unverified.

[Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/rewards/profile-and-preferences/add-address.html). Live, signed in.

Primary-address checkbox; home/business/other type; country selector; address line one; optional second line; postal/ZIP code; city; state; save/cancel. Country selection must drive region choices and applicable requirements. The country selector contains legacy spellings and duplicates: preserve underlying identifiers and have the content owner resolve display-name corrections. The editor was exited with Cancel.

### A05 — Reservations

[Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/reservations/reservation-index.html). Live, signed in.

Upcoming, past and cancelled tabs. Upcoming and past empty states were observed. No populated booking was available to inspect. Reservation detail, modification, cancellation, receipts and policy-dependent actions must be verified using a suitable test reservation; do not infer a functioning cancellation flow from the tab label.

### A06 — Rewards activity

[Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/rewards/rewards-activity.html). Live, signed in. Heading and shell loaded, but no transaction rows or meaningful activity controls were rendered. This is an observed blank state, not evidence of a verified activity-table schema. A useful redesign needs loading, empty, failure and populated states; the proposed table in the redesign is explicitly a design proposal.

### A07 — Message center

[Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/rewards/message-center.html). Live, signed in. A wallet-navigation button appeared; no populated messages, read/unread filters, or message detail was available. Keep the route; verify actual message data before finalizing a production message model.

### A08 — Favorites and authentication

The account shell contains a heart and favorites markup; a usable saved-items list was not observed. Login is a shared interaction rather than a verified dedicated route. Password-help is linked from customer service. Preserve login, return-to-original-task, enrollment, recovery, session expiry and logout flows. Exact login/recovery fields and populated favorites require inspection; do not log out the user's session to test them.

## 7. Destination and brand coverage

Destination hierarchy: worldwide directory → country → state/province/region → city/theme → hotel → room. A destination is content; a search result is date-sensitive inventory. Do not merge them into one static page.

Directory themes observed: national parks, beaches, music festivals, theme parks, pets, spa/wellness, casinos, Route 66 and extended stays. Geography covers US states and Washington DC; Canadian provinces/regions; Mexico/Central America; South America; Caribbean; Europe; Asia/Pacific; Africa; Middle East. Individual directory links and nested destinations are not all body-reviewed. [Source](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/hotels/destinations.html)

Homepage destination links include Anaheim, Austin, Boston, Calgary, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Houston, Key West, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, Miami, Monterey, Montreal, Myrtle Beach, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Orlando, Phoenix, Portland, San Antonio, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Barbara, Toronto, Vancouver and Virginia Beach. Seasonal tiles are separate campaign content and can change.

Brand inventory observed across the live homepage and public brand directory:

|---|---|
| Best Western | Best Western, Plus, Premier, BW Premier Collection, BW Signature Collection, Executive Residency, GLō, Vīb, Aiden |
| SureStay | SureStay, SureStay Plus, SureStay Collection, SureStay Studio |
| WorldHotels | Luxury, Elite, Crafted, Distinctive, Backdrop |

Homepage grouping includes aspirational, collection, boutique, timeless, value and extended-stay categories. Portfolio counts differ across rendered/indexed material; keep membership in a managed data collection and derive the displayed count from the current source. [Brand directory](https://www.bestwestern.com/en_US/hotels/discover-best-western/brands.html)

## 9. Content migration model

Use one route register and reusable templates while retaining every individual record. A template cannot replace the unique body content of its instances.

| Entity | Required retained fields |
|---|---|
| Route | Original URL, canonical URL, locale, content type, template, parent, redirect, evidence status, fetch date |
| Editorial page | Title, ordered sections, body, images/captions/alt text, linked destinations, CTA labels, disclosures, metadata |
| Hotel | Property code, identity/contact, location, all descriptive sections, amenities, policies, nearby records, images, review source |
| Room / rate | Stable identifiers, beds/occupancy, amenities, imagery, eligibility, price basis, currency, taxes/fees, cancellation/deposit terms |
| Offer | Region, audience, enrollment requirement, booking/stay windows, benefit, exceptions, status, CTA, terms/version |
| Destination | Geographic hierarchy, introductory body, themes, nearby destinations, hotel relationships, assets |
| Brand | Name, logo, category, description, assets, features, discovery link and external/local ownership |
| Rewards | Tiers and effective dates, earn/redeem rules, partner catalog, country eligibility, disclosures |
| Member | Authenticated profile/contact/preferences, membership and wallet records; never public static content |
| Legal/support | Full approved body, effective date, region, contact channel and availability |

Keep content fidelity separate from visual redesign. Do not copy old campaign dates into a new active promotion. Do not fabricate reviews, hotel rates, room inventory, partner redemptions, reservation numbers or account transactions.

## 10. Remaining work before claiming complete parity

- Obtain an authoritative CMS/property export or finish a verified body crawl for all retained URLs. The URL map is a starting register, not the complete site database.
- Reconcile navigation links and sitemap exports with the register; recurse through destination subdirectories and external services.
- Validate canonical URLs, malformed mapped entries, old campaigns, aliases and redirects. Some map results are bare seed paths or suspicious suffixes.
- Capture every hotel's unique content and all assets, including captions, alt text and responsive variants.
- Inspect date-dependent results, room selection, checkout and confirmation using non-production test data.
- Inspect populated bookings, wallet, messages and activity; the inspected account did not expose those records.
- Resolve the blank communications iframe, favorites surface, recovery flow and country-dependent form rules.
- Capture all legal/support bodies and third-party forms; this document indexes them rather than reproducing them.
- Run parity checks: each source page/section/option maps to a target component or explicit external handoff. No unreviewed row may be marked complete just because its template exists.
